queue_row_numbering: one-based data-row order, excluding the CSV header
viewing_method: six generated contact sheets with derived fire boxes rendered in red at original sheet resolution

classification_definitions.acceptable: visible fire is plausibly covered by the rendered box or the background image correctly contains no localized fire target
classification_definitions.questionable: a label may include smoke/non-fire content, be unusually fragmented, or cannot be judged reliably at the rendered resolution
classification_definitions.incorrect: no visible fire is covered by the rendered box at the review resolution

interpretation: The queue is deterministic and stratified by split and smallest normalized box area; it is not a simple random prevalence sample.
Single-reviewer contact-sheet judgments do not establish whole-dataset label-error prevalence.
Questionable and incorrect samples require full-resolution adjudication before correction, exclusion, or final split freeze.
